items.title: Live: Celebrations mark ceasefire in Lebanon, as Netanyahu says Israel will stay put
items.description: The US State Department says a 10-day ceasefire will enable negotiations toward a permanent security and peace agreement. Follow live.

items.title: A 10-day ceasefire in Lebanon begins: What to know today
items.description: Israel and Lebanon agree to a 10-day ceasefire, but Israel's military will remain on Lebanese territory, meaning Hezbollah's conditions were not met.

items.title: PM preparing Australia for protracted Middle East conflict
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese insists Australia's sanctions on Russia and Iran will remain in place as the world scrambles to secure oil supplies amid a global crisis triggered by the Strait of Hormuz blockade.

items.title: Some Australians fear lockdowns. Economists say stagflation is the bigger risk
items.description: As fuel costs surge and supply fears grow, businesses and households say the economic shock from the war in the Middle East is already hitting home.

items.title: Live: Refinery fire won't bump Australia to stage three of fuel plan: PM
items.description: Anthony Albanese says the fire at the Geelong refinery won't lead to a change in Australia's fuel security plan. Follow live.

items.title: Australia’s fuel supply: Where things stand and what we’re watching
items.description: We know you have to get where you're going this weekend. ABC News is here to help with a round-up of all the key news on fuel price and supply in Australia.

items.title: What we know about the 'small fire' that became an 'unprecedented' Geelong refinery blaze
items.description: The "unprecedented" fire at one of the two remaining oil refineries in Australia took more than 12 hours to extinguish. Here's what we know about how it unfolded.

items.title: In charts: A look at Australia's record spending on defence
items.description: The Defence Department reveals where the money will be going as Australia plans to spend a record $425 billion over the next decade.

items.title: Australia is on the verge of aged care AI boom
items.description: Artificial intelligence-enabled robot companions, personal behaviour monitors and pain management apps could soon be used more widely within the sector.

items.title: Migration debate deserves less politicking from the Liberals
items.description: The Liberals need to resolve the internal ambiguities they have on big policy questions when it comes to migration.

items.title: Coca-Cola flags it could pull out of Qld recycling scheme
items.description: The Queensland government recently introduced proposed laws to overhaul the governance of the scheme, while also ruling out an increase to the 10-cent refund amount.

items.title: Mother of 13 who 'never thought we’d be homeless' pleads for help
items.description: Finding a home for a large family in a regional area has left one family camping on the side of the highway in rural New South Wales. Nationally, Indigenous people are over-represented in homelessness statistics.

items.title: Australian billionaire Andrew Forrest battles Meta over fake ads
items.description: Australian billionaire mining magnate Andrew Forrest is asking a US federal court in Silicon Valley to hold Meta accountable for scam ads using his likeness without permission.

items.title: AFL-backed helmet company pulls concussion claims after ABC report
items.description: An AFL-endorsed helmet company has backtracked on its claims of "superior protection against concussion" and the league is now also facing a complaint lodged with the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission on the matter.

items.title: Are you growing Australia’s next invasive weeds in your garden?
items.description: Agapanthus, morning glory or gazanias might be easy-growing plants in your home but their invasive nature can damage your garden and the environment. Here's what experts recommend.

items.title: Weekly news quiz: Trump's AI image, a 200m record and the Artemis II splashdown
items.description: It's Friday, and that means it's time to test your news knowledge from the past seven days. Were you paying attention this week?

items.title: How mobile phone cameras have helped unearth a mysterious kingdom
items.description: An exhibition bridges the gap between art and science by inviting visitors to imagine the world through the senses of other species and consider our own fragile relationship with nature.

items.title: Elderly couple beg council to let them stay in Gold Coast caravan park
items.description: Time is running out for residents facing eviction from Kirra Beach Tourist Park. In 2018, the council told them they needed to move out by 2028 to make way for tourists, but with rising rent and property prices, they say they cannot afford to live anywhere else.

items.title: Live: Wall Street pushes record highs
items.description: Wall Street markets post record highs despite the uncertainty of the Middle East conflict. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Pope blasts 'tyrants' spending big on war following public spat with Trump
items.description: The US-born pope has praised peace movements and peace makers during his visit to the African nation of Cameroon as the rift with US President Donald Trump intensifies.

items.title: Decision looms as Ben Roberts-Smith expected to apply for bail
items.description: Australia's most decorated living soldier has spent more than a week in custody. Today in court, he is expected to make a bid to be released on bail after being charged with war crimes.

items.title: 'Same general, new clothes': Civilian facade as military hides wealth in Thailand
items.description: As the Myanmar military carried out air strikes during a brutal civil war, the junta chief's family quietly purchased luxury real estate in Thailand.

items.title: 'Plate to paddock': How a festival's waste became a farmer's treasure
items.description: Tonnes of organic waste from the National Folk Festival are being turned into fertiliser on a farm outside Canberra in a circular economy project delivering more benefits than just waste reduction.

items.title: 'Shattered' Blue feels he let Carlton down in narrow loss to Collingwood
items.description: Carlton coach Michael Voss says the club will support Elijah Hollands after his performance against Collingwood last night.

items.title: Trbojevic injures hamstring as Manly thrash Cowboys
items.description: The Sea Eagles have smashed North Queensland but the win has come at a heavy cost following a hamstring injury to star fullback Tom Trbojevic.
